Built: (1) gateway browser_sites.rs (new, CRLF): org-admin GET/PUT of the org site policy (require_active_org + owner/admin role, forwarded via proxy_json to org-core /api/v1/organizations/:id/browser-sites); member GET /me, PUT/DELETE /me/{host}, GET explain?host=; strict body validation (unknown fields refused, expected_revision required, mode/rule/level enums, rules<=500, notes<=200, host charset, 64 KB cap) before anything reaches org-core; routes exist only when BROWSER_DO_ENABLED is literally 'true' (read once when classed_routes is built, so they are absent when off), merged into browser.rs classed_routes so the session layer applies. (3) settings-sections.ts: ids browser-sites and org-browser-policy. (4) ChatMessages.tsx: exported browserSiteConsentChoices (never more than the admin ceiling; empty under ZDR), browserSiteConsentLabel, BrowserSiteConsentCard (nb+en). NOT MOUNTED, see lead_todo.
